## Summary

I found the live site, the GSC export, and the repo told three different parts of the same story: **this SaaS pivoted from "InboxZap" (an email-cleanup tool) to "Lumina" (an AI meeting assistant), and the migration was left half-finished.** GSC's top queries are almost entirely old-business terms (`bulk delete emails`, `gmail storage full`, `unsubscribe newsletters`, `inbox zero`) ranking at position 40-60 with near-zero clicks — the 12 existing blog posts are 100% about the dead product and structurally can't rank for anything Lumina actually sells. Meanwhile `inboxzap`/`inboxzap app` brand queries still convert at position ~4-8, so there's real residual equity being wasted.

On the repo side I found concrete bugs, verified each with a full `next build` + local server test:

1. **`app/layout.tsx` still shipped the dead brand as the default metadata** (title "InboxZap — Clean Your Inbox in Minutes", `og-inboxzap.png`). Any page without its own override would have regressed to that on next deploy. Replaced with Lumina-branded defaults, `metadataBase`, a title template, full OG/Twitter tags, and sitewide `Organization` JSON-LD.
2. **`/features`, `/pricing`, `/faq` had no source files at all** — they only existed on the live mock. Rebuilt all three as real routes with per-page metadata.
3. **`/faq` was 404ing in production.** The `next.config.js` redirect sent it to `/#faq`, but the homepage has no `#faq` section — a dangling fix from "the redesign." Replaced with a real FAQ page, including a Q&A entry on the InboxZap→Lumina rename that captures that branded search intent instead of losing it to confusion.
4. **The blog was entirely client-rendered** (`'use client'` + `fetch('/api/posts')`, and that API doesn't exist) — crawlers saw a loading spinner, nothing else. Rebuilt as server-rendered: `app/lib/posts.ts` + a real `app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx` with `generateStaticParams`/`generateMetadata` and `BlogPosting` JSON-LD.
5. **Replaced the 12 off-topic legacy posts** (which were getting thousands of impressions but no relevant audience) **with 301 redirects to `/blog`**, and added 5 new posts actually targeting Lumina's ICP keywords (AI meeting notes, meeting-assistant comparison, action-item follow-through, Zoom/Meet/Teams integration) — plus one post telling the InboxZap→Lumina story directly.
6. **`sitemap.ts` had a literal `// TODO: include blog posts`** and omitted `/faq` — fixed to generate all real routes dynamically.
7. **`og:image` 404'd everywhere** (file never existed) — generated a real placeholder PNG at `public/img/og-lumina.png`.

Verified: `next build` compiles all 14 routes cleanly, the FAQ returns 200, legacy post URLs 308→`/blog`, the sitemap lists every real page, and homepage head tags now render consistent Lumina branding + JSON-LD.

Not done (flagged, out of scope for "organic traffic"): `npm install` surfaced a known high/critical security advisory on `next@14.2.5` — worth a separate upgrade pass since bumping frameworks isn't a pure content/SEO change.
